verdict.rationale: Column documents programmatic opening of FDIC-insured bank accounts and a sandbox where every route is sandboxed and data persists like production, so the core story is covered. However, the full path from application through KYC/KYB review to an active account is not documented end-to-end; KYC is mentioned only briefly, and manual review is an option. missing for 10: documented application-to-active lifecycle (statuses and activation steps), evidence that onboarding/KYC can complete fully programmatically without manual review, independent hands-on corroboration of account opening and sandbox parity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a real, insured deposit account through the API — application to active account fully programmatic, with sandbox parity so the flow is tested before launch

citations.quote: Programmatically open and manage FDIC insured bank accounts at Column on behalf of your customers.
Every route is sandboxed and data persists exactly like in production.
Bring your own KYC/KYB process, or use our KYC/KYB verifications with support for manual reviewing.
When you create an API key, you must specify if that key can access sandbox or live mode.
